svg.text: The diagonal block seen per register: which of the 64 lanes keep register e
Each row is register e's 64-bit lane mask, and the next register's mask is this one shifted left by 1 (within a group of four
columns) or by 5 (to the next group), in each 32-lane half. Held in an SGPR pair, the mask can feed v_cndmask directly
and be advanced with s_lshl_b32 per half: one VALU instruction per register instead of the v_cmp + v_cndmask pair.
